## SMOOTHNESS SCORECARD (order 1643Z): smoothness first, income as a floor. Per book (alone-bare A row vs fix_A when it exists, else the in-mix M row vs the live mix), per session mix and the whole day. ACCEPTABLE = smoother (worst week AND weekly st.dev.) than the same entries on their fixed bracket in >= 2/3 of the quarters, in both NQ-up and NQ-down weeks, and income above the floor; the three floors (income no more than 10% / 20% / 30% below the fixed bracket) are all shown: Josh picks. Biggest give-back = peak open profit minus exit (peak from the 1-s tape: the engine rows do not store MFE; W-DYNH: please add the best favorable price per trade as a column to make this exact). Slot effects = entries the managed run took that the bracket run did not (freed slots) and entries only the bracket run took (blocked). Policy rules are not judged here: see POLICY_PRICE_LIST.md.

Judged B, C, D against A first (does management add to the bare entry), then against E (E = registered row bareE, else the live mix as run). ## SUNDAY EXIT-MANAGEMENT PICKS (order 1515Z/Saturday 16:00Z; sets sun*, variant M = inside the live mix with Trade Health and live layers vs the live mix as run). One row per book and side: the best FINISHED setting by the standing rule (prior-year filter PY first, then max DD and worst week vs live, then L6M income); PASS-W = W-SUNDAY rule (max DD and worst week not worse than live, L6M DD not deeper, income >= 97% of live, DD shallower in >= 7 of 12 13-week periods, prior-year filter) else WEAK; PASS-H = harness rule (beats live on DD and worst week with income within 10%, or more income with DD not deeper; L3M and L6M not worse; random-management null not applicable to a fixed setting). JOINT rows appear when joint sets (side J) are registered; until then the profit pick and the loss pick are shown separately and are NOT a tested pair. All 896+ sets are listed in autopilot/SUNDAY_SETS_ALL.md. Sets are read as soon as 42 months are DONE; unfinished sets only show progress.
